why: This service has no healthcheck: it is 'healthy' while serving errors, and rolling update, rollback and restart_policy have nothing to decide on.
bad:
services:
  mongo:
    image: mongo:8.2.3
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mongosh", "--eval", "db.adminCommand('ping')"]
  api:
    image: registry/api:1.2.3
    init: true
good:
services:
  api:
    image: registry/api:1.2.3
    init: true
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "dist/healthcheck.js"]
      start_period: 20s
